newsitem.title: CHINA: CHINA EVERBRIGHT BUYS KUMAGAI GUMI STAKE.
newsitem.headline: CHINA EVERBRIGHT BUYS KUMAGAI GUMI STAKE.

text.p: Kumagai Gumi (Hong Kong) Ltd said it would issue 42 million new shares to Maddington Ltd, a wholly-owned unit of China Everbright Holdings Co Ltd, at HK$8.37 a share, raising net proceeds of about HK$350.6 million.

The company said in a statement on Thursday that China Everbright Holdings intended to keep the shares, which represent about 10.12 percent of Kumagai Gumi's enlarged issued share capital, as a long term investment.

Kumagai Gumi said the placement would allow it to explore joint venture business opportunities with China Everbright Holdings. "It is also intended that a representative from China Everbright Holdings will be invited to join the board," it said.
The net proceeds raised would be used as working capital.
Trading in Kumagai Gumi shares was suspended on Wednesday morning and was due to resume on Thursday.
Shares of the construction company rose HK$0.40, or 4.6 percent, to HK$9.10 ahead of Wednesday's trading suspension.

China Everbright Holdings, controlled by China's State Council, has three listed units in Hong Kong - China Everbright International Ltd, China Everbright Technology Ltd and China Everbright-IHD Pacific Ltd.
